request.report: Round for spec-replay. Verified state: off-greedy, A-greedy, B-greedy, off-prod all present with 4 phases each. Greedy shows n-gram spec does NOT help with both slots busy (dual-agent off 26.3 vs A 25.5/26.1 vs B 23.0; dual-mem off 25.0 vs A 23.8 vs B 22.4); A also introduces looping length-finishes. Corrected spec_replay.py confirmed (window lines + t_end in off-prod; t0 set before bg thread start). Next: run A-prod (A = higher dual-agent greedy) to complete the corrected prod measurement and get combined two-slot throughput for the off vs A decision. No infra/deploy yet.
request.why: Complete the prod arm set. off-prod already ran with the corrected probe (window lines, per-row t_end); A-prod uses the same corrected script with --spec-type ngram-mod so its dual-phase combined fg+bg throughput can be compared to off-prod as the 'both slots busy' decision metric.
